prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: game prop PBR base-colour texture for wooden cargo pallets beneath jute sacks in Lowtide's dockside warehouse. One square full-bleed photographic wood material scan, 2048 x 2048 intended texture.
Primary request: generate crisp believable weathered pallet deck boards, replacing a blurry grey texture that reads like stone. The material must unmistakably read as wood.
Composition: exactly four equally wide horizontal boards stacked vertically, all grain and board lengths running left to right. Each board spans the whole image width without any end joints. Very narrow straight dark-brown hairline board separations at one quarter, one half and three quarters of the image height. Repeatable material scan, consistent detail all the way to each image edge.
Materials: aged dry pine cargo-pallet timber, pale muted grey-tan with natural beige-brown fibres, clear fine directional grain, a few small subdued knots, shallow hairline longitudinal checks, light handling scuffs and darker dusty pores. Wood is sound and mostly smooth, with modest coarse sawn fibre detail, not bark, not heavily splintered. Each board has slight natural tone variation. No painted surface, no glossy varnish, no large stains, no lichen and no deep gouges. No giant knots or grooves.
Lighting: perfectly even diffuse albedo scan, with no baked shadows, ambient occlusion, perspective, bevel shading, highlights, vignette or light gradient. The game supplies all lighting and shape.
Constraints: texture only, no pallet silhouette, backing, surrounding warehouse, sacks, floor, objects, metal, stone, mosaic, tile pattern, screws, bolts, nail heads, text, stamps, labels, logos, watermark or PBR map grid. No vertical board joints or seams.
